reason: I'd maybe try the free tier to snap a whiteboard into class notes, but I don't pay for apps, and Notes plus Google Docs already sync between my phone and laptop. Five apps and 50 actions is probably enough for me, so there's no reason to upgrade.
objection: Moving all my notes into a new app that might not stick around, when what I have works fine and costs nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A free student or first-year deal, plus whiteboard photos turning into clean, searchable notes far better than just saving the picture in Google Docs.
